effect.kaleidoscope_flora.purge.descript: Continuously removes harmful status effects, clearing up to three each tick.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.floating.descr: Allows swimming through the air and prevents fall damage.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.fadeaway.descr: Makes nearby monsters and phantoms stop targeting you.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.drowsy.descrip: Slows nearby monsters and makes nearby phantoms stop targeting you. Drinking another cup extends the effect.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.tastebloom.des: Food restores extra hunger and saturation. Grants Haste while your hunger bar is full.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.firebrand.desc: Your attacks set targets on fire for six seconds.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.vampiric.descr: Your attacks heal you for a portion of the damage dealt.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.harvest.descri: Doubles or triples mature crop drops for up to 20 harvests, attracts nearby dropped items, and prevents trampling farmland.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.absolve.descri: Blocks the next three harmful status effects applied to you.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.petalwalk.desc: Allows walking on the surface of water. Sneak to dive beneath the surface.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.divination.des: Every eight seconds, may heal you, restore hunger, or grant a brief burst of Speed.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.kiss.descripti: Taking damage poisons nearby creatures. This can trigger once every five seconds.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.wither_aura.de: Inflicts Wither on nearby hostile creatures and mobs that have a target, excluding owned pets.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.sniffer_soul.d: Use a brush on soil, sand, gravel, or moss to dig up seeds, pottery sherds, and other buried treasures. Each find consumes some effect duration.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.sunward.descri: Grants Regeneration under an open daytime sky. Makes you glow at night.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.thorns.descrip: Reflects a random portion of incoming damage back to the attacker and inflicts Weakness on them.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.digestion.desc: Each stackable item dropped by a creature you kill has a 50% chance to gain one extra item.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.petal_veil.des: Blocks incoming projectiles. Each block consumes ten seconds of effect duration, with a brief grace period between charges.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.echo.descripti: Consumes itself to save you from a lethal hit, attempts to teleport you to nearby safe ground, and grants brief protection and movement boosts.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.sprout.descrip: Accelerates the growth of nearby crops and other supported plants.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.gaze.descripti: Makes nearby creatures glow and slows creatures you look at directly.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.wish.descripti: Grants random blessings chosen from Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II, Haste II, and Luck.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.flower_path.de: Leaves a trail of wildflowers as you walk. Holding a supported ground-cover block places it from your hand instead.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.toasted_cake.d: Doubles hunger exhaustion while active and briefly applies Slowness when it expires.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.dew_cake.descr: Allows an extra jump in midair and prevents fall damage.
effect.kaleidoscope_flora.pinned.descrip: Pins you in place and prevents jumping.
